# Project Atlas

Atlas is a developer CLI that compresses terminal output before it reaches an AI assistant.
It focuses on preserving the next action rather than replaying every line verbatim.

## Why

Long command output is often mostly repetition, progress chatter, and boilerplate.
Agents need the failures, file names, commands, and follow-up hints.

## Install

```bash
brew install devr-tools/atlas/atlas
atlas self doctor
```

## Quickstart

- `atlas sync` pulls the latest workspace data.
- `atlas test` runs the standard validation suite.
- `atlas explain <cmd...>` shows why a profile matched.

## Configuration

Set `ATLAS_MODE=agent` to bias output toward shorter previews.
Project-local rules can override built-in profiles.

## Troubleshooting

If a reducer becomes too aggressive, rerun the command with `atlas compare`.
If a command is missing a specialized reducer, start with `atlas bench`.
